crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do…
My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
I and the Father are one.”
For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should…
I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so…
All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

translations.web: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
translations.bsb: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
translations.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
translations.asv: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:
